class Box {
  #stored = 0;
  get value(): number { return this.#stored; }
  set value(value: number | string) { this.#stored = Number(value); }
  set label(value: string) { console.log(value); }
}
function setOne<K extends 'value'>(box: Box, key: K, value: string) {
  box[key] = value;
}
function setBoth<K extends 'value' | 'label'>(box: Box, key: K, value: string) {
  box[key] = value;
}
function setBound<T extends Box, K extends 'value'>(box: T, key: K, value: string) {
  box[key] = value;
}
const box = new Box();
setOne(box, 'value', '5');
console.log(box.value);
setBoth(box, 'label', 'hello');
setBoth(box, 'value', '7');
setBound(box, 'value', '8');
console.log(box.value);
